correctness.rationale: Exact cyclotomic zero iff the seven phase exponents constitute a permutation of F7. All 7^6 normalized words were enumerated with two complete independent integer parameterizations: absolute phase tuples and cyclic increments. Their 5-rank histogram, 12 zero-row profiles and totals coincide, and polynomial-degree strata provide a further cross-check. Weyl diagonalization identifies support cardinality with full complex Gabor lifting rank. Limits are finite and specified.

value.rationale: A natural complete classification of all 117649 projective seven-phase codewords by exact Gabor matrix-recovery rank, refined to all 12 zero-row profiles and polynomial-degree strata. The sharp nonquadratic rank37 onset and 14406 matching codes quantify a novel seventh-root resonance absent from the published six-root seven-cycle case. These ranks are directly linked to the invisible Weyl directions of cyclic Gabor intensity measurements; no unsupported conditioning claim is made.
